no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was sought since the benefit/risk profile of vemurafenib demonstrated in this application is clear for the proposed indication.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for the Zelboraf (vemurafenib) NDA202429. The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Summary Review, and Office Director memo all independently state the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the benefit/risk profile was clearly favorable for the proposed indication. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
